summary: REQ-1 appears implemented in `frontend/firestore.rules` by adding an `allow create` rule under `match /users/{userId}` requiring authentication and `request.auth.uid == userId`. However, the diff also shows additional Firestore rules changes beyond the requested self-profile create permission (e.g., new match block for `/profile/users/{userId}` and new helper functions/permission logic), which may violate the constraint to only modify rules as needed and not add additional capabilities.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a new rules match block allowing authenticated users to create documents under `/profile/users/{userId}`.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only specifies enabling self-profile document creation for the app’s profile path `users/{userId}`. Adding permissions for a separate collection/path is not requested and could be considered an added capability.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced/changed helper functions and additional access-control logic (e.g., `userDocExists()`, revised `isSuperAdmin/isHelperAdmin/isApproved` checks, and multiple `allow read/update/delete` statements) beyond the specific requested `allow create` rule.
hallucinated_features.reason: The request constrains changes to “only modify Firestore security rules as needed” to permit self CREATE on `users/{userId}`, and to avoid altering other permissions except as required. The diff indicates broader rule logic changes; it’s not verifiable from the summary whether these were strictly required for REQ-1.
